story.summary: The wallet now refuses an overdraft. This page explains the change, then shows how far each promise is proven.
story.problem: Before this PR, a withdrawal could take the balance below zero.
story.change: The withdraw function now refuses an amount above the balance, and a new function adds a fee.
story.trust: A planted bug proves the overdraft rule. The promises below show the weak parts.

story.title: Before and after
story.description: Before the PR, the wallet paid out any amount. After it, the wallet checks the balance first.

loop.title: One withdrawal
loop.description: What the wallet does with one call.

loop.intro: One call takes an amount from a balance. Each step links to the promise that protects it.

steps.text: A caller asks the wallet to take an amount from the balance.
The wallet refuses an amount above the balance, and else it gives the balance minus the amount.
The PR also adds a fee function and a denial message, but the withdraw function does not call them yet.

change.intro: The PR changes the wallet core and adds two modules and a report script.

notes.bin/report.py: New. It reads a file of accounts and prints each balance. No claim covers it.

risks.why: The balance test checks only the type of the result.
risks.fix: Assert the exact new balance in the test.

tradeoffs: The fixture is small, so each level is short.
verifications: The e2e test runs each step on this fixture.
